notes.title: Polish Constitution Days Discount
notes.content:
Yoo guys!
We're excited to celebrate Polish Constitution Days in our devs' homeland. To mark the occasion, we have a challenge for you! 

Beat our time "1.17.29", complete the full game in the shortest time possible & earn souvenirs.* 

The discount on Gauntler is only valid until next Monday, so don't hesitate to grab a game and share your thoughts with us!

*Challenge rules:
1. This is 100% type speedrun, you need to complete all basic and bonus levels (to unlock bonus lvls you need to collect all green gems)
2. Every challenger must collect all green gems (stars are not obligatory).
3. Souvenirs will be awarded to those who submit a video on the Steam Community Hub, through DMs on our social media, or by email to this address: contactdeezgames@gmail.com.
4. After sending the video to us, we'll check if your speed run is correct. If so, we'll contact ya on the platform you send the video (remember to allow sending DMs from others).


Link to the speedrun video:Gauntler Speedrun
